description: This file defines the class `VolleyMultipartRequest`, a custom implementation extending the Volley `Request` class to handle multipart/form-data uploads, including both text parameters and binary data (files). It facilitates sending multipart HTTP requests with support for attaching data parts and handling responses and errors.

classes.name: VolleyMultipartRequest
classes.description: A custom Volley request to support multipart/form-data uploads, handling both text and binary data parts.

classes.name: DataPart
classes.description: Inner class representing a binary data part with filename, content byte array, and optional MIME type.

methods.name: VolleyMultipartRequest
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the request with method, URL, and response/error listeners.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns the request headers if set, otherwise default headers.

methods.name: getBodyContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type header string for multipart/form-data with boundary.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the byte array representing the multipart request body, including text and binary parts.

methods.name: getByteData
methods.description: Protected method meant to be overridden to provide data parts for upload; defaults to null.

methods.name: parseNetworkResponse
methods.description: Parses the network response into an appropriate Response object, handling errors.

methods.name: deliverResponse
methods.description: Delivers the parsed response to the success listener.

methods.name: deliverError
methods.description: Delivers errors to the error listener.

methods.name: textParse
methods.description: Helper method to write text form fields into the multipart body.

methods.name: dataParse
methods.description: Helper method to write binary data parts into the multipart body.

methods.name: buildTextPart
methods.description: Writes a single text form field into the DataOutputStream.

methods.name: buildDataPart
methods.description: Writes binary data (file) into the DataOutputStream, including headers for filename and content type.
